cases.name: Tuyết Anh Phan
cases.about:
Tuyết was of Vietnamese descent, and her ashes were returned to Vietnam to be with her parents. Tuyet worked at a McDonald's across the street from City Hall and was described by neighbor Suong Ly as a "good person."

Her obituary said: "She was the brightest spark in this world and will be deeply missed by everyone who's lives she touched. Tuyet was the epitome of a strong, independent woman. Lively and vibrant, she viewed life with such optimism that was honest and heartfelt which spilled over to everything she did. Living life to the fullest, she embraced every moment, every challenge willingly and eagerly. She always saw the beauty and wonder in everyday life, enjoying even the simplest, mundane things. Tuyet was the kindest soul, never hesitating to give a helping hand to a friend, a neighbor, a stranger. Being friendly, compassionate and charitable was just part of who she was. Thank you for being part of our lives Tuyet. We will hold you in our hearts forever, never to be forgotten."
cases.narrative: On 2/3/2022, investigators discovered her body buried in his backyard. He lived right across the street in their mobile home park. A neighbor described hearing a loud bang coming form her home.
